events.label: Наука
entries: 1884 – The International Meridian Conference designates the Royal Observatory, Greenwich as the world's prime meridian.

1962 – Cuban Missile Crisis: President Kennedy, after internal counsel from Dwight D. Eisenhower, announces that American reconnaissance planes have discovered Soviet nuclear weapons in Cuba, and that he has ordered a naval "quarantine" of the Communist nation.
1975 – The Soviet uncrewed space mission Venera 9 lands on Venus.
1992 – Space Shuttle Columbia launches on STS-52 to deploy the LAGEOS-2 satellite and microgravity experiments.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1724 – J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Schmücke dich, o liebe Seele (Adorn yourself, O dear soul) in Leipzig on the 20th Sunday after Trinity, based on the communion hymn of the same name.
1883 – The Metropolitan Opera House in New York City opens with a performance of Charles Gounod's Faust.
1987 – John Adams' opera Nixon in China premiered at the Houston Grand Opera.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1746 – The College of New Jersey (later renamed Princeton University) receives its charter.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1964 – Jean-Paul Sartre is awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature, though he does not accept the prize.
